result: Real GDP grew at a 3.4% annual rate in Q3 (2.2% in Q2; consensus about 3.2%); the September PCE price index rose 0.5% on the month and 3.6% on the year, and core PCE rose 0.3% and 3.1% (3.0% in August). event: European Central Bank monetary policy decision, Oct 29
result: The ECB kept its key deposit rate at 2.50%, as expected; the same day Christine Lagarde announced she will step down as ECB President on Feb 7, 2027, before her term ends in October 2027. Figures as reported by AFP (via The Manila Times) and Reuters (via Global Banking & Finance); the ECB release was not fetched this run.

event: China official (NBS) PMIs for October, released Oct 31
result: The official manufacturing PMI fell to 49.3 in October from 50.1 in September (50 expected) and the non-manufacturing PMI was 49.7. Figures as reported by China Daily and Global Times; the NBS release was not fetched this run.
The ISM Manufacturing PMI was 55.5% in October, up from 54.5% in September; new orders 55.5%, employment 52.4%, prices 75.2% (down from 77.9%).
